description: Perpetual-futures funding rates. Pass `symbol` (e.g. 'BTC') to get current per-venue rates for one asset. Omit `symbol` to get top cross-venue funding-arbitrage opportunities (pre-ranked, normalised to daily %, spreads >= 0.3%). Each arb row includes long_exchange+long_daily_pct, short_exchange+short_daily_pct, spread_daily_pct. A halted or no-longer-polled venue (Coinbase International, halted 2026-10-01) is left out, and so is a venue silent for over an hour in the per-symbol list.

symbol.description: Specific symbol (e.g. 'BTC'). Omit for all symbols.
